Use case: stylized-concept. Near-photographic cinematic painterly realism for the Korean post-collapse road-trip game Seoul to 400km. Grounded Korean people and infrastructure, restrained cool gray-blue palette, wet or dusty weathered materials, one practical warm amber light source where inhabited, natural anatomy, human-scale action, subtle film grain, believable 35-50mm film-still composition. Match the attached Caravan canonical references exactly in medium, palette, character identity and vehicle design.
Asset type: ONE transparent live-game vehicle BODY COMPONENT, NOT a scene or full vehicle. Input 1-3 are material/world references; input 4 technical vehicle identity; last image is the exact existing Dalguji body design to derive this new component from.
Primary request: First rear extension: same low cream-colored living box as last reference, a narrow riveted extension bay at far left, rear vertical ladder. Three amber-glass side windows, access door with smaller window toward RIGHT. Minimal increase in height; long low rectangular box. No upper storey.
STRICT orthographic SIDE VIEW matching the final reference truck facing right, perfectly horizontal roof and floor. Only the rectangular independent living-box compartment, complete from bare flat roof rail to its lower metal skirt; cut the entire DRIVER CAB, all WHEELS, CHASSIS, roof CARGO and antenna OUT of this component. No roof accessories. Roof must have empty mounting surface for optional game parts. Black frame trim, worn beige paint, rusty bolts, credible aluminum and steel. Keep windows and seams sharp and generously sized at game scale. No people, no scenery, no cast shadow beyond object. Soft neutral daylight; do NOT bake a night scene.
Output: large master 1536x1024 with REAL transparent alpha. One centered rectangular component approximately 1.85:1 width:height, fills 90% canvas width, all sides uncut. No other objects.
Avoid: anime, manga, comic book, ink outline, cel shading, cartoon, chibi, pixel art, glossy advertising photo, hyperreal skin pores, fashion editorial, studio portrait, 3D render, game-engine screenshot, fantasy, zombies, neon cyberpunk, clean sci-fi vehicle, American RV, panel van, readable text, logo, watermark, UI, frame, collage, split panel
